pick.headline: Urgent Care Clinic Becomes Emergency Room at Precisely the Moment of Billing
pick.take: Same waiting room, same chairs, same stethoscope, but the claim form has been upgraded to emergency. Acuity is now determined by the billing office, which has never once been wrong about what it can charge. Affordability is a top voter issue, and the invoice is doing its part.
